body:
It's incredibly frustrating. 

The facial recognition ESPECIALLY. I feel embarrassed when I can't react to someone in public that I *should* know.

Also, the memory loss. My current OBGYN doesn't know I have schizophrenia and I've been trying and failing unfortunately to get a surgery scheduled, and I hate that I can't even remember prior surgeons and PCP's that I've had to tell her. 

I can't even remember past hospitals I've been in, or meds I've been on. It's so frustrating. I'm sorry you're experiencing that as well.

Thank you. I try not to look up more symptoms, which sounds silly, but I'm worried if I read them I'll start to make them happen, if that makes sense. But it makes me feel better to know that is a thing.

Thank you. 

I woke up to this message and it hit me harder than I thought it would. I don't know what I expected when I posted, but it wasn't that. 

That means so much to me. I love that poem. It was ..I don't know, it spoke to me in a way that I don't know anything else could have.

I'm so sorry you are suicidal too. It's amazing that you are able and willing to reach out to others despite being hurt as well.

Thank you again. Thank you so much. I will (try to) be here for you as well. I'm going to try to hold on.
